ns2:section.sectionText: [Expanded itle: Introduction to Technology in Library and Information Science] 2 or 4 hours; be sure to enroll in your desired amount of credit hours. LEEP students; Non-LEEP students may enroll on a space-available basis with consent of Associate Dean Linda Smith (lcsmith@illinois.edu); Academic Outreach restrictions and assessments apply, see http://www.continuinged.illinois.edu/outreach/. Required on-campus session Saturday, March 5. See section description for 490TE at http://www.lis.illinois.edu/academics/courses/catalog . Instructor: Elizabeth (Edwards) Beers.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to CAS:Lib & Info Sci Online-UIUC or MS:Library & Infor Sci -UIUC.
